summary: Create a database. A full list of performance level options can be seen by executing `az sql db list-editions -a -o table -l LOCATION`.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the Azure SQL Database.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --server
parameters.help: Name of the Azure SQL Server. You can configure the default using `az configure --defaults sql-server=<name>`.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Assign identity for database.

parameters.name: --availability-zone
parameters.help: Availability zone.

parameters.name: --backup-storage-redundancy
parameters.help: Backup storage redundancy used to store backups. Allowed values include: Local, Zone, Geo, GeoZone.

parameters.name: --encryption-protector
parameters.help: Specifies the Azure key vault key to be used as database encryption protector key.

parameters.name: --encryption-protector-auto-rotation
parameters.help: Specifies the database encryption protector key auto rotation flag. Can be either true, false or null.

parameters.name: --exhaustion-behavior
parameters.help: Specifies the behavior when monthly free limits are exhausted for the free database.AutoPause: The database will be auto paused upon exhaustion of free limits for remainder of the month.BillForUsage: The database will continue to be online upon exhaustion of free limitsand any overage will be billed.

parameters.name: --federated-client-id
parameters.help: The federated client id for the SQL Database. It is used for cross tenant CMK scenario.

parameters.name: --free-limit
parameters.help: Whether or not the database uses free monthly limits. Allowed on one database in a subscription.

parameters.name: --ha-replicas
parameters.help: The number of high availability replicas to provision for the database. Only settable for Hyperscale edition.

parameters.name: --keys
parameters.help: The list of AKV keys for the SQL Database.

parameters.name: --ledger-on
parameters.help: Create a ledger database, in which the integrity of all data is protected by the ledger feature. All tables in the ledger database must be ledger tables. Note: the value of this property cannot be changed after the database has been created.

parameters.name: --license-type
parameters.help: The license type to apply for this database.``LicenseIncluded`` if you need a license, or ``BasePrice``if you have a license and are eligible for the Azure HybridBenefit.

parameters.name: --maint-config-id
parameters.help: Specified maintenance configuration id or name for this resource.

parameters.name: --max-size
parameters.help: The max storage size. If no unit is specified, defaults to bytes (B).

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --preferred-enclave-type
parameters.help: Specifies type of enclave for this resource.

parameters.name: --read-scale
parameters.help: If enabled, connections that have application intent set to readonly in their connection string may be routed to a readonly secondary replica. This property is only settable for Premium and Business Critical databases.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --umi
parameters.help: The list of user assigned identity for the SQL Database.

parameters.name: --yes
parameters.help: Do not prompt for confirmation.

parameters.name: --zone-redundant
parameters.help: Specifies whether to enable zone redundancy. Default is true if no value is specified.

parameters.name: --catalog-collation
parameters.help: Collation of the metadata catalog.

parameters.name: --collation
parameters.help: The collation of the database.

parameters.name: --sample-name
parameters.help: The name of the sample schema to apply when creating thisdatabase.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --capacity
parameters.help: The capacity component of the sku in integer number of DTUs or vcores.

parameters.name: --edition
parameters.help: The edition component of the sku. Allowed values include: Basic, Standard, Premium, GeneralPurpose, BusinessCritical, Hyperscale.

parameters.name: --family
parameters.help: The compute generation component of the sku (for vcore skus only). Allowed values include: Gen4, Gen5.

parameters.name: --elastic-pool
parameters.help: The name or resource id of the elastic pool to create the database in.

parameters.name: --service-level-objective
parameters.help: The service objective for the new database. For example: Basic, S0, P1, GP_Gen4_1, GP_S_Gen5_8, BC_Gen5_2, HS_Gen5_32.

parameters.name: --auto-pause-delay
parameters.help: Time in minutes after which database is automatically paused. A value of -1 means that automatic pause is disabled.

parameters.name: --compute-model
parameters.help: The compute model of the database.

parameters.name: --min-capacity
parameters.help: Minimal capacity that database will always have allocated, if not paused.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
